name: Yawgmoth Demon
description: A demon of the Phyrexian realm who follows Mishra through the portal wanting his power.

description_citations.text: "Antiquities War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Suwwardi enslave Mishra; he sees a Phyrexian realm in a vision, controls a dragon engine with the Weakstone and is accepted by the tribe, later confederating the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: Later he can confederate the several Fallaji tribes under his central control.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod use the Weakstone on the Thran Crystal at Koilos, opening a gateway to a hellish mechanical world, where the Yawgmoth Demon attacks and follows them back.
timeline.quote: When he uses the Weakstone on the Crystal, a gateway to the other world is opened.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 4". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
